message.subject: last call: give a friend a month of Claude Pro 🚀
message.body:
know someone who'd love to get mentorship? they get Claude Pro

-
[https://img.mmdocdn.com/mailmodo/image/upload/ar_122:31,c_crop/v1730807558/editor/p/ee04e184-c8ca-43e2-b3d0-02540dfb0927/c77676d5faa9d00daa6805bdd25d2c3e_yhm5r3.png]https://adplist.org


CLAUDE PRO MONTH ENDS FRIDAY. GIVE YOUR FRIENDS AN INVITE

Sofiene,

 

Final call.

 

Friday at midnight, the Claude Pro reward campaign closes
[https://app.adplist.org/invite]. Invites keep working, friends keep their free
mentorship for life, but the month that was yours simply disappears.

 

You're 2 of 10 invites [https://app.adplist.org/invite]. That's 8 forwards
standing between you and it. Open your messages, find the last three people who
asked for help, and send!

 

Friday. Then nothing.

Invite friends today [https://app.adplist.org/invite]
